<?php
class Base143 {
    public int $seed = 5;
    public function __construct(int $step) {
        echo 'B', $step, '|';
        $this->seed += $step;
    }
    public function label() { return static::class; }
}
function make143() {
    global $input143;
    return new class($input143) extends Base143 {
        public function __construct(int $step) {
            echo 'A', $this->seed, '|';
            parent::__construct($step);
            echo 'C', $this->seed, '|';
        }
    };
}
$input143 = 3; $first = make143();
$input143 = 4; $second = make143();
echo $first !== $second ? 'different|' : 'same-object|';
echo $first::class === $second::class ? 'same-class|' : 'different-class|';
echo $first->label() === $first::class ? 'called|' : 'wrong-called|';
echo $first->seed, '/', $second->seed;
cases.provenance: Byte-identical independent CLASS143 typed frontier; original native and corrected Unsupported baseline reused without replay.

class Base144Retry { public int $value = 0; }
function fail144Retry() { throw new Exception('stop'); }
function make144Retry() {
    global $fail144;
    return new class($fail144 ? fail144Retry() : 3) extends Base144Retry {
        public function __construct($n) { $this->value = $n; }
    };
}
$fail144 = true;
try { $failed = make144Retry(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
$fail144 = false; $a = make144Retry(); $b = make144Retry();
echo $a !== $b ? 'fresh|' : 'bad|', $a::class === $b::class ? 'same|' : 'bad|', $a->value, '/', $b->value;
